
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/yanshajiuzhou/p/19813443" title="发布于 2026-04-02 17:46">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Windows 安装 OpenClaw 记录</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1171560/202604/1171560-20260402174652860-1480803338.png" alt="Windows 安装 OpenClaw 记录" class="desc_img">
        本文分享了在Windows 11系统下安装OpenClaw的经验。作者介绍了两种教程的配合使用方法：先按教程1安装，遇到问题时参考教程2排错。建议初学者选择有免费额度的QWen模型，并详细说明了修改配置文件和重启服务的步骤。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>OpenClaw 这么火，大家皆在养小龙虾。我不养一下的话，过不得。所以这两天稍空了一点，在本地安装了一波。</p>
<p>不少云服务商已经集成了 OpenClaw，如果不想自己本地安装的话，可以花十来元体验一波云 OpenClaw。</p>
<p>我本地系统是 Win11。安装时，找了一些教程，一步一步按着教程来，有问题了，再在网上搜解决方法。我找了两个教程，基本按照着来，没得什么问题的。两个教程相辅相成。</p>
<p><strong>教程1：</strong><span class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_inline cke_widget_csdnlink cke_widget_wrapper_link-info cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" data-cke-enter-mode="2" data-cke-saved-href="https://blog.csdn.net/sunnytony/article/details/158663253?ops_request_misc=elastic_search_misc&amp;request_id=f7b89cb50ffbce130e05c97a30d072cc&amp;biz_id=0&amp;utm_medium=distribute.pc_search_result.none-task-blog-2~all~ElasticSearch~search_v2-1-158663253-null-null.142^v102^pc_search_result_base2&amp;utm_term=windows%20%20安装使用%20open%20claw" data-cke-widget-editable="text" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-link-icon="https://csdnimg.cn/release/blog_editor_html/release2.4.6/ckeditor/plugins/CsdnLink/icons/icon-default.png?t=Q239" data-link-title="OpenClaw 在Windows下的安装" data-widget="csdnlink" rel="noopener nofollow">OpenClaw 在Windows下的安装</a></span></p>
<p><strong>教程2：</strong><span class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_inline cke_widget_csdnlink cke_widget_wrapper_link-info cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="a 小部件" data-cke-display-name="a" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="0" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1"><a class="link-info cke_widget_editable cke_widget_element" title="OpenClaw 安装报错？这份排坑清单帮你省下 3 天折腾时间" contenteditable="true" href="https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2014661903826322386" data-cke-enter-mode="2" data-cke-saved-href="https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2014661903826322386" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fzhuanlan.zhihu.com%2Fp%2F2014661903826322386%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22OpenClaw%20%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85%E6%8A%A5%E9%94%99%EF%BC%9F%E8%BF%99%E4%BB%BD%E6%8E%92%E5%9D%91%E6%B8%85%E5%8D%95%E5%B8%AE%E4%BD%A0%E7%9C%81%E4%B8%8B%203%20%E5%A4%A9%E6%8A%98%E8%85%BE%E6%97%B6%E9%97%B4%22%2C%22desc%22%3A%22%22%2C%22icon%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcsdnimg.cn%2Frelease%2Fblog_editor_html%2Frelease2.4.6%2Fckeditor%2Fplugins%2FCsdnLink%2Ficons%2Ficon-default.png%3Ft%3DQ239%22%2C%22isCard%22%3Afalse%2C%22hasResquest%22%3Atrue%2C%22iconDefault%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcsdnimg.cn%2Frelease%2Fblog_editor_html%2Frelease2.4.6%2Fckeditor%2Fplugins%2FCsdnLink%2Ficons%2Ficon-default.png%3Ft%3DQ239%22%2C%22id%22%3A%22L8VtVD-1774962572503%22%2C%22classes%22%3A%7B%22link-info%22%3A1%7D%7D" data-cke-widget-editable="text" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-link-icon="https://csdnimg.cn/release/blog_editor_html/release2.4.6/ckeditor/plugins/CsdnLink/icons/icon-default.png?t=Q239" data-link-title="OpenClaw 安装报错？这份排坑清单帮你省下 3 天折腾时间" data-widget="csdnlink" rel="noopener nofollow">OpenClaw 安装报错？这份排坑清单帮你省下 3 天折腾时间</a></span></p>
<p>按照 教程1 来安装，报错了按 教程2 来排错。可以适当关注 教程1 里参考的博客。</p>
<p><strong>注意：</strong>选择模型时，可以先选择&nbsp;<strong>QWen</strong> 试试水，有免费额度。MiniMax（Coding Plan）貌似没有免费额度，我一用就报错了。更改模型时，注意更改配置文件：<strong>openclaw.json</strong>，在&nbsp;C:\Users\自己的用户名\.openclaw\ 下。改了配置文件后，可以删除&nbsp;<strong>agents </strong>文件夹，也在&nbsp;C:\Users\自己的用户名\.openclaw\ 下。然后重启 openclaw gateway。</p>
<p>token 是消耗得真快，我问了几个问题，免费 token 就没有了。</p>
<p>大家，加油。</p>
<p style="text-align: right"><span style="color: rgba(53, 152, 219, 1)">德才兼备，提拔重用；有德无才，难当重任；有才无德，以济其奸。-- 烟沙九洲</span></p>

</div>
